title: Campbell's tightening conjecture for minimal thick matroids
statement:
Let $t$ be a positive integer, and let a matroid be $(t+1)$-thick when it is not the union of $t$ hyperplanes. A **tightening** is the matroid operation described in the source, and let the matroid described in the source's example be the reference matroid. **Campbell's tightening conjecture.** Every minimal $(t+1)$-thick matroid is a tightening of the reference matroid.

This conjecture concerns the structure of extremal examples for the associated covering problem. It was proposed by Rutger Campbell, but the supplied text gives no resolution, so it remains open.
source_name: Hailong Dao, Manik Dhar, Izabella Łaba and Ben Lund, “Covering points with planes”, arXiv:2502.08945 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.08945

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2025).
